hypotheses.A: Simple ML adds repeatable probability and net return information beyond fixed volume/momentum and trend controls.
hypotheses.B: Chronological out-of-fit probability calibration improves Brier/log loss; volatility sizing is compared with a training-exposure-matched control.
hypotheses.C: EWMA scaling improves interval score and tail behavior versus rolling volatility, not coverage alone.
hypotheses.D: Historical news adds information only after availability, event diversity and time-coverage eligibility gates pass.

primary_metrics.A: outer Brier relative to training base rate, net results reported without automatic promotion
primary_metrics.C: mean interval score with coverage, tails and width

fixed_ablations: raw/shrink/sigmoid probability mappings selected only within training
config.promotion_policy: No automatic promotion on previously searched history. Require prospective shadow evidence; record all failed and negative results.

data_quality.adjustment_provenance: unknown; caller must verify consistent OHLC

decision_clock: XNYS session close; theoretical immediate availability, no vendor SLA
price_adjustment: consistent adjusted OHLC assumed from input; cache vendor lineage not independently certified
